CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

3. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming.

4. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   D. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

10. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

13. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

14. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

----
